title: Minimum Recolors to Get K Consecutive Black Blocks
summary: Find the fewest white blocks to recolour so that one run of k neighboring blocks is black.

examples.note: The first seven positions contain three white blocks, and no length-seven group needs fewer recolours.

recognitionClues: Every candidate group contains exactly k neighboring blocks.
The cost of a group is the number of white blocks inside it.
Neighboring candidate groups overlap in all but one position.
